sloka: पूजिते त्वयि धर्मज्ञ पूजां प्राप्नोति मारुतः ।तस्मात्त्वं पूजनीयो मे शृणु चाप्यत्र कारणम् ॥५-१-१२२॥
transliteration: pūjite tvayi dharmajña pūjāṁ prāpnoti mārutaḥ ।tasmāttvaṁ pūjanīyo me śṛṇu cāpyatra kāraṇam ॥5-1-122॥

translations.english: "O knower of righteousness to worship you is to honour the Windgod. Therefore you are worthy of worship for me. I will tell you the reason. Listen.
